question: Should OpenClaw add a durable spawned-session root/trace metadata contract now, and what exact trace semantics should that contract use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but naming and semantics for traceId affect stable Gateway/session APIs and must align with existing diagnostic traces, usage-family lineage, and adjacent recursive listing work.

options.title: Approve narrow chain metadata
options.body: Define rootSessionKey plus a durable spawned-session chain trace id, keep the change additive, and require focused native/ACP spawn plus list-projection tests.

options.title: Defer behind lineage alignment
options.body: Keep this issue open until resolver-family lineage, recursive listing, and diagnostic trace terminology are reconciled into one public contract.

options.title: Reject core chain fields
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide spawned DAG reconstruction should remain external or plugin-owned rather than a core session contract.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow chain metadata
recommendation.body: Define rootSessionKey plus a durable spawned-session chain trace id, keep the change additive, and require focused native/ACP spawn plus list-projection tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this item with the same product/API concern and has recent adjacent session model/projection history.
